children: TruGolf advanced its acquisition of Polymath by signing an amendment that finalizes the preferred equity consideration. The Series C preferred stock will be issued based on a $140 million reference amount, with a $1,000 stated value per share and a $3.94 conversion price into Class A common stock. Conversion will occur automatically following required stockholder approval and, if needed, Nasdaq approval, with a 19.99% aggregate ownership cap in effect until then. The amendment complements the previously announced Acquisition Agreement under which Polymath will amalgamate with TruGolf’s Canadian subsidiary, and Polymath shareholders will receive 19.9% of TruGolf’s pre-closing Class A plus Series C preferred.
